input.title: Add an accessible name to the site search input
input.rationale: The search input (type="search", name="q") in the header's role="search" form has no label, aria-label or aria-labelledby, so screen readers announce it without a name. The form's only visible text is the "Search" submit button, and there's no visible label element to point aria-labelledby at. Adding aria-label="Search the site" names the field without changing the layout. A reviewer could also consider adding a visible <label>, which would help sighted users too, but that means changing markup and isn't possible with attribute-only edits.
